comment: RECORDED SEED — the office's post-Prospect lifecycle outcomes (captain, 2026-10-03).
These are app-authored demo rows, NOT a service response: no contract under
docs/08-delivery/contracts/ names a lifecycle / engagement record, so the office's own
durable store folds this seed with an append-only journal (lib/api-client/lifecycle-store.ts,
ONE FACT, ONE SOURCE: every figure below comes from the client's own 2026 sheets through
casket SRPs), and each engagement LINKS to the prospect it came from (prospect_id) and
the recorded agent (agent) so the office can follow one person from enquiry to outcome.
tests/fixture-contract/lifecycle.test.ts pins the amounts to the catalogue.
AMORTIZATION IS DERIVED, never stored: `amount_cents` is the contract total, `mode` the
payment interval, `installments` the count, and `first_due_on` the first date. The schedule
is an even split with the last installment carrying the remainder (lib/lifecycle.ts).
NOTICES are modular templates the office edits (label · days_before · message). The app
schedules one per open installment per active template; no email/SMS service is connected,
so a notice is held in-system (NOTICE_TRANSPORT_NOTE) — never claimed as delivered.
DEMO DATA ONLY: names, phones and emails are invented .test placeholders.

CLEAN START (captain, 2026-10-02/03): the recorded demo engagements and payments are REMOVED. The office records a post-Prospect outcome (a plan member, a service, a lot or a product) itself; the notice templates remain as configuration. A record is written through /api/staff/lifecycle.
